💰 MI HB 6222 — Michigan Limits Crypto Kiosk Transactions to $500 Daily

Michigan is regulating cryptocurrency exchange kiosks with the new ‘Cryptocurrency Exchange Kiosk Regulation Act’. The law limits transactions at these kiosks to $500 per day per person, requiring operators to implement ‘reasonable measures’ to prevent fraud and suspicious activity, including 24-hour hold periods for new user transactions. ...
